Map library unavailable. Leaflet could not be loaded from any CDN, so the map panels are switched off. Every property, filter, tab, grouping, search and export still works, and each card keeps its Google Maps link.
Map integrity: Every entry is plotted. Precision is stated per pin rather than implied.
Nothing is withheld from the map any more, as you asked. The trade-off is that precision now varies, so it is labelled on every pin and card.

All properties

By country and region

Click any item to jump the map and open its property card.

Update tools

Everything is client-side. Your edits stay in this browser unless you export.

Import refreshed JSON

Paste an exported hotel array or JSON object with a hotels key. This replaces the in-memory data and saves to localStorage.

Paste Relais sitemap text

Open the official sitemap, Select All, copy, and paste. The parser extracts country headings and first-level property names, ignoring restaurant/spa child links when possible.

Open Relais & Châteaux property sitemap

Geocode missing pins

For country-level Relais pins, this will try OpenStreetMap Nominatim one by one. Use sparingly and export after. If blocked, use Google Maps links per card.

Nominatim has usage limits. For production, use a paid geocoder or run the Python updater included next to this HTML.
